headline: CBOE VIX Volatility Index Touches 19-Month High Above 40
summary: The CBOE Volatility Index briefly spiked to 40.03—its highest level in 19 months—before easing to 30.12, reflecting market anxiety over tech sector leadership and Federal Reserve rate decisions.
why: The VIX measures 30-day implied volatility of S&P 500 index options and serves as Wall Street's primary benchmark for stock market risk perception.

impacts.name: CBOE Volatility Index
impacts.why: Options pricing reflected surging demand for downside protection during equity market swings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heightened equity price swings and interest rate policy uncertainty caused option premiums on the S&P 500 to jump.
